exporter: resoloop blender export --parent Root --preserve-hierarchy (offline, not applied)
notes: Exporter copies FLOAT_COLOR/POINT values verbatim (no sRGB encode, no clamp to 1). postprocess.VERTEX_COLOR_SPACE = "Linear". Exporter warns that PBS_Metallic does not display vertex colours; a vertex-colour material (PBS_VertexColorMetallic) must be bound.
